description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-delivery">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerOrder" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerReturn" name="Customer return"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomerOrder" name="Place customer order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderPlacement" name="Customer begins placing an order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ChannelChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannel" name="Choose order channel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ChannelChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channel_Online</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Channel_Phone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" name="Place order online">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channel_Online</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Online_OrderPlaced</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" name="Place order over the phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Channel_Phone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Phone_OrderPlaced</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderPlacedOnline" name="Online order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Online_OrderPlaced</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderPlacedByPhone" name="Phone order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Phone_OrderPlaced</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ChannelChoice" sourceRef="Start_OrderPlacement" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Online" name="Online platform" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Channel_Phone" name="Phone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Online_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" targetRef="End_OrderPlacedOnline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Phone_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" targetRef="End_OrderPlacedByPhone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderDelivery" name="Process and deliver order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Customer order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderReceived_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderReceived_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateLabel_Handover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateLabel_Handover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Handover_SendTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTrackingInformation" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Handover_SendTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendTracking_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendTracking_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_WaitForDelivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ShipmentReachesAddress" name="Shipment reaches customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_WaitForDelivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delivery_SuccessEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ShipmentReachedAddress">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shipmentReachedCustomerAddress</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SuccessfulDelivery" name="Successful delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delivery_SuccessEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReceived_GenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Generate_SendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmation_PickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPack_GenerateLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateLabel_Handover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Handover_SendTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTracking_Monitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTrackingInformation" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_WaitForDelivery" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="Event_ShipmentReachesAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_SuccessEnd" sourceRef="Event_ShipmentReachesAddress" targetRef="End_SuccessfulDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PostDeliveryFollowup" name="Post-delivery follow-up" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackReceived" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_FollowupMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnReceived" name="Customer return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReturnReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerReturn"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_FollowupMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FollowupMerge" name="Feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_FollowupMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_FollowupMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Followup_TakeAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherAction" name="Take further action">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Followup_TakeAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FurtherAction_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FurtherAction" name="Further action completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FurtherAction_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_FollowupMerge" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Gateway_FollowupMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_FollowupMerge" sourceRef="Start_ReturnReceived" targetRef="Gateway_FollowupMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Followup_TakeAction" sourceRef="Gateway_FollowupMerge" targetRef="Task_FurtherAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherAction_End" sourceRef="Task_FurtherAction" targetRef="End_FurtherAction"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderDelivery">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_CustomerOrder"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderOrganization" name="Order processing organization" processRef="Process_OrderDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PostDeliveryOrganization" name="Order processing organization - post-delivery follow-up" processRef="Process_PostDeliveryFollowup"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Customer order via online platform" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Customer order by phone" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandOverShipment" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTrackingInformation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerReturn" name="Customer return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_ReturnReceived" messageRef="Message_CustomerReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
